findings.message: Laterality contradiction within the same follow-up note: the subjective states pain and tenderness are exclusively in the left knee with the right knee asymptomatic, while the assessment states the current symptomatic knee is the right knee with the left asymptomatic.
findings.rationale: Subjective localizes current symptoms to the left knee only; the assessment on the same date localizes the same current symptomatic knee to the right side. These directly conflict on laterality of the active symptomatic side.

evidence.quote: Today pain and tenderness are exclusively in the left knee. The right knee is asymptomatic.
The same current symptomatic knee is the right knee; the left knee is asymptomatic.
